data.name: 青蛙飞跃 Frog Leap
data.detailed_description:
Frog Leap is a precision platformer built on a simple, challenging premise: you are a frog whose only form of movement is a charged jump. Your goal is to ascend a vertically stacked world, relying solely on skill and patience.

Core Mechanics
The controls are minimalist but demand high precision:

  • SPACE - Jump: Your frog cannot walk. All movement is executed by jumping.

  • A/D Keys - Left/Right: Use the A/D keys for left/right adjustments on the ground.

  • Hold SPACE - Charge: Hold the SPACE bar to charge your jump. The longer you hold, the higher and farther you leap.

  • Save: Fully automatic saving, no manual saving or checkpoints, and players cannot correct mistakes by loading saves.

The Challenge & Experience
The difficulty stems from mastering physics and spatial judgment. Every jump is a critical test—undercharge and you'll fall short; overcharge and you'll overshoot into the abyss. Levels are meticulously designed with platform size, spacing, and layout to test your rhythm and error management.

Failure is an integral part of the learning process. Falling often means restarting from the beginning, forcing you to learn from mistakes, memorize patterns, and optimize your path. Success is not based on luck, but on the muscle memory and precise control honed through repeated practice.

In Summary
This is a game for players who enjoy tough challenges and refining their skills. It strips away all distractions, offering pure satisfaction from overcoming difficult obstacles and reaching the summit through sheer precision.

data.short_description: Challenge yourself in this precision platformer! Your character can only move by charging jumps—no walking. Leap left or right, but beware: one misjudgment can mean a long fall. Persevere through punishing climbs to reach the summit. How high can you go?
